verdict.rationale: A probe confirms a live, machine-readable OpenAPI spec at https://developers.cloudflare.com/openapi.json (contains an 'openapi' key), plus llms.txt indexes and per-product llms.txt/Markdown mirrors for the entire docs corpus, giving AI-native users multiple machine-readable spec formats. Missing for 10: no independent/community corroboration of the OpenAPI spec's completeness or usage beyond the first-party probe.
